items.summary: Investigate and fix the 'failed to submit quiz' error in the quiz submission flow. Audit the submitQuizAnswers (or equivalent) mutation in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts and the corresponding backend handler in backend/main.mo. Ensure the data shape sent from QuizQuestionsPage.tsx matches the expected backend parameter types (e.g., sector, answers array, question IDs). Fix any type mismatches, missing fields, incorrect Candid encoding, or error-handling gaps. On successful fix, the quiz must submit without error and navigate the user to the Dashboard.
